bio_am: Ծնած է Սասնոյ Ահարոնք գիւղը՝ 1866-ին։ Տարօնի եւ Սասնոյ մէջ Դաշնակցութեան հիմնադիրը, ինկաւ 1904-ի Սասնոյ ապստամբութեան ընթացքին։
bio_en: Armenak Ghazarian, known as Hrayr Dzhoghk ('Hell') and Urvakan ('Ghost'), was born in 1866 in Aharonk in the Khulb district of Sasun; as a child his family fled Kurdish oppression to Kizil-Aghach in the Mush plain, and he finished his schooling in 1890. He joined the revolutionary circles that existed in Mush when Mihran Damadian arrived in 1891 and, after the first Sasun events of 1894, returned from the Caucasus as the ARF's representative to found the party in Taron and Sasun, recruiting fighters such as Keri Tado and Cholo. A rare 'writer-warrior', he wrote moving reports on the oppression of the Armenian peasantry and, with Andranik, Sebouh, Smbat and Gevorg Chavush, led the Sasun uprising of 1904. He was killed in its fighting, after having carried the wounded Sebouh off the battlefield.
